interpretation: Work-level aggregation of lexical passage retrieval. Every edge in the top-level edges list is RETRIEVED_AS_CANDIDATE: it records that two works produced a passage pair above the retrieval threshold under one TF-IDF configuration. It is not a resemblance claim, and no edge in this file asserts descent or borrowing.

edge_semantics.RETRIEVED_AS_CANDIDATE: lexical neighbourhood coincidence under the stated retrieval model
edge_semantics.COMPARED_WITH: two coded versions were put through the structural comparison; the component vector is the output of that operation, not a verdict
edge_semantics.RESEMBLES: reserved for a reviewed assessment against the stated promotion criterion; this build emits zero such edges
edge_semantics.SOURCE_DEPENDENCE: documented transmission, translation, embedding or shared witness
edge_semantics.DESCENDS_FROM | BORROWS_FROM: adjudicated historical relation; not produced by this build

selection: Top 100 discovery work pairs and top 50 known-dependence work pairs by maximum eligible passage cosine; full passage pairs remain in v2_candidate_pairs.jsonl

layers.name: narrative_structure
layers.edge_meaning: Two annotated narrative versions were compared event-by-event, role-by-role and adjudicated-motif-by-motif; the component vector reports the outcome of that comparison and nothing more.
layers.resemblance_promotion_criterion: an edge may be relabelled RESEMBLES only when a reviewer records that (a) both witnesses are independently attested rather than merely unmarked, (b) the same comparison class applies, (c) every component above zero sits on an assessed domain that is not flagged thin (motif domain at least 2 and at least 2 aligned event pairs), (d) at least one component survives the gap and weight sweeps, and (e) that decision is recorded with a reviewer. Each edge carries resemblance_admission with (a)-(c) computed; no edge in this build is promoted, so the layer contains zero RESEMBLES edges.
